prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I found two passenger vehicles stopped in the travel lanes with visible contact on their driver-side and passenger-side panels respectively. Driver 1 stated that Driver 2 moved into the lane Driver 1 was occupying while changing lanes, and that the two vehicles made contact along their sides. Driver 2 confirmed the lane change and the contact, and did not dispute the sequence of events. Two independent witnesses on the shoulder described the same movement and said they saw the vehicles touch. I took photographs of both vehicles, which show scraping and panel damage consistent with a sideswipe at moderate speed. I confirmed through the scene and witness accounts that Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported dizziness and a headache following the collision and described symptoms consistent with a concussion; Driver 1 was transported for evaluation. Nothing I observed or was told suggests prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 identified the policyholder as a household member residing at the same address.
